narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A short bill on the shop counter, the quire already under his arm. Field is at the type and is not in this line of sight. No play-title is on the paper. The bill, on the bookwheel. He turns the bill over. The back is blank. He does not write a hall, a sum, or a name.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the quire and did not write a second line.

entities.name: bill
entities.context: Shown on bill in One quire, the old trade
